# S54 — Show the ork version and logo in the terminal: TUI, --version, doctor

Follows S53. The owner wants the ork version shown in the TUI (2026-10-20, from a screenshot of the Overview: the footer reads '14 projects | refreshed 10:58:47 | pending 0' and the top-left reads 'ork ?help') and the logo in the terminal too: a small ASCII or Unicode mark in the TUI header or splash, and a one-line glyph in the ork --version and ork doctor output. A terminal cannot show the SVG, so this slice adds a text version of the chosen mark. The TUI also shows when the daemon's build differs from the TUI's (S46 later note L1: the stale warning is hidden by the alternate screen); the daemon.info call from S46 gives the daemon's build id.

## Why

The version should show where ork runs, which is the terminal. Today the TUI header reads "ork  ?help" (internal/tui/view.go:98), and the build only shows in `ork --version` (cmd/ork/main.go:100-103) and `ork doctor` (internal/cli/doctor.go:180-184).

A stale daemon is invisible while the TUI runs. The stale check prints to stderr before the TUI starts (cmd/ork/main.go:150, internal/cli/lifecycle.go:57-61), and the alternate screen hides that output. The TUI needs its own check and a status-line marker.

The owner decided (2026-10-20, adj record 130 and the answers that followed) on: the version next to the name in the header; the stale-daemon warning in the status line; a six-row text mark in `ork --version`, `ork doctor` and the top of the `?` help screen; no launch splash; no real-image protocol. The mark is a text version of assets/logo-square.svg, drawn with half-block characters in teal, blue, violet and orange, with a no-colour and an ASCII fallback.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests first: internal/brand/mark_test.go (new, SPDX line), the new cmd/ork and internal/cli doctor tests, and the new TUI header, status and help tests. Update cmd/ork/main_test.go:154-161 to the new --version shape.
2. Create internal/brand/mark.go (new, SPDX line). Keep the pixel grid as 12 strings of 12 letters (T, B, V, O, .) from .scratch/drafts/S54/mark.txt. Derive the cell rows: cell row L takes pixel rows 2L (top) and 2L+1 (bottom). Use half blocks: top only = U+2580 in top colour; bottom only = U+2584 in bottom colour; both same = U+2588; both different = U+2580 with fg top and bg bottom; neither = space.
3. In brand, add the ASCII rows from mark.txt and a Fallback(getenv) that takes ASCII unless LC_ALL, LC_CTYPE or LANG names UTF-8 (first non-empty wins).
4. Mark(colour bool) returns six strings. Colour uses lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color(hex)). Check the pinned Lip Gloss v2 API (go doc charm.land/lipgloss/v2) before writing the colour path.
5. cmd/ork/main.go:100-103: print the mark and then "ork VERSION". Colour only when stdout is a terminal (stdlib: os.File and ModeCharDevice) and NO_COLOR is unset.
6. internal/cli/lifecycle.go:31-38: CheckDaemonBuild returns (string, error). cmd/ork/main.go:150 keeps the stderr warning and passes the build on.

Open: the version string, the help height rule, the header when the sidebar is hidden, the shared stale helper, and the status-line wording are listed in Failing-tests.md.

Proposed defaults for the open points (the owner can change them; none is an adj decision):
- Version string: the `version` var unless it is "dev", else the first 7 characters of vcs.revision from build info (record: daemon.build-id), plus "+" if vcs.modified.
- Help height: draw the mark above the help only when the body is tall enough for the mark and all help lines; otherwise omit it.
- Header when the sidebar is hidden (`s`): show the version at the right of the status line instead.
- Stale rule: export one helper from internal/daemon that cli and tui both call; do not copy it.
- Status-line wording: short, under 60 characters, for example "daemon build differs: ork daemon restart".

The mark (from the design draft; keep it as 12 strings of 12 letters, T teal #6ee7d2, B blue, V violet, O orange, . empty; take the exact B, V and O hex values from assets/logo-square.svg):
 r0   .....TT.....
 r1   ....T..T....
 r2   ....T..T....
 r3   ....TTTT....
 r4   .....TT.....
 r5   .....TT.....
 r6   .....TT.....
 r7   .TTTTTTTTTT.
 r8   .T...TT...T.
 r9   .BB..VV..OO.
 r10  .BB..VV..OO.
 r11  .BB..VV..OO.
Cell row L takes pixel rows 2L (top) and 2L+1 (bottom). Glyph rows when drawn in one colour:
    ▄▀▀▄
    █▄▄█
     ██
 ▄▄▄▄██▄▄▄▄
 ▀▄  ▀▀  ▄▀
 ██  ██  ██
ASCII fallback (non-UTF-8 locales):
    .--.
    |  |
    '--'
     ||
 +---||---+
 ##  ##  ##

Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): (1) version string: the version var unless it is dev, else the first 7 chars of vcs.revision plus + if modified; (2) draw the help mark only when the body fits it and all help lines; (3) with the sidebar hidden, show the version at the right end of the status line; (4) export one stale-rule helper from internal/daemon for cli and tui; (5) status-line wording under 60 characters, for example 'daemon build differs: ork daemon restart'. The proposed defaults above are accepted.
